name: Ubugoe
source:
You play a man whose wife is humiliated and has a baby by someone else.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE024948.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
玩家將扮演一名男子，他的妻子遭人凌辱，並替別人懷孕生子。
